full.title: Who Santiago is
full.text: Santiago is a Cloud Engineer at Readymind. Santiago designs, builds and operates tools on Azure: from infrastructure to product.

full.title: The year in three numbers
full.text: A portal in production with 204 clients, 5 internal tools in a year and 6 Microsoft certifications.

full.title: The main project
full.text: A portal that connects Partner Center with the account managers' work, read-only. Each card opens with the problem, the idea and Santiago's role.

full.title: Santiago's specialty: disaster recovery
full.text: Santiago automated the recovery test: from 2 hours to 45 minutes, without touching production and with evidence for audits.

full.title: Beyond the day-to-day
full.text: Santiago's first hackathon: Belo Business, built as a team in one day and presented live to the jury.

full.title: Certifications
full.text: Six Microsoft certifications, each one verifiable on Learn. SC-100 is in progress.

full.title: What Santiago writes
full.text: Real Azure cases: first a short version on LinkedIn and, when the topic calls for it, the extended one here.

full.title: Talks
full.text: Webinars and talks with live demos. If you're organizing an event, the speaker kit has a bio, photos and topics.

full.title: So you don't miss the next one
full.text: A real Azure case by email, with the query or script that solved it. Free.

full.title: That's all
full.text: If you'd like to talk about cloud, product or a talk, write to Santiago. And if you're looking for something afterwards, tap me: I'm still down here.
